column1: 21002§stagnant§ˈstæɡnənt§Because of economic crisis, our company's sales have remained stagnant.§由于经济危机，我们公司的销售额**停滞不前**。§改例句：“销售额”应为复数 sales，谓语相应改为 have
21003§attach§əˈtætʃ§They attached the coupon to the front of the letter.§他们把优惠券**附**在信的正面。§
21004§flip§flɪp§A switch was flipped and the machine began to operate.§**轻弹**开关，机器便开始运作。§

21005§comment§ˈkɒment§Customers' comments, both positive and negative, are recorded by staff and are collated regularly to identify opportunities for improvement of products.§员工记录来自顾客的正反两方面**意见**，（公司）定期整理核查这些意见，以确定是否能根据意见来提高产品的质量。§改例句：泛指顾客，所有格应为复数 Customers'，Customer's 错
21006§flame§fleɪm§The house was in flames.§房子失**火**了。§
21007§emphasize§ˈemfəsaɪz§This report emphasizes that cancer is not caused by a single element in cigarette smoke.§这一报告**强调**，癌症并不是由香烟烟雾中的某单一成分导致的。§
21008§foresee§fɔːˈsiː§What changes do you foresee in the educational field in the next 50 years?§在未来的50年里，你**预见**教育界会发生什么变化？§改译文：原译“认为”没有译出 foresee（预见），改为“预见”
21009§historic§hɪˈstɒrɪk§There are a number of historic ships docked in the harbour.§这个港湾停泊了很多**具有历史意义**的船舶。§
21010§provision§prəˈvɪʒn§The country has enough provisions of grain for the next several years.§这个国家备有足够的粮食**储备**以供未来几年使用。§改例句：the future several years 语序和用词错，应为 the next several years
21011§president§ˈprezɪdənt§A lecture will be given by the president of the Union.§该协会**主席**将发表演讲。§
21012§internist§ɪnˈtɜːnɪst§The professor who teaches us is a respected internist.§教我们的那个教授是一位受人尊敬的**内科医师**。§
21013§reception§rɪˈsepʃn§The students' dormitory is to the right of the reception desk.§学生宿舍在**接待处**的右边。§
21014§suspend§səˈspend§The party representative suspended the talk with the government.§该党代表**暂停**了和政府的对话。§
21015§untrustworthy§ʌnˈtrʌstwɜːði§Allen should have known better than to lend such a large sum of money to that untrustworthy cousin of his.§艾伦应该知道把这么一大笔钱借给他那**不可靠**的堂兄是不明智的。§
21016§prospective§prəˈspektɪv§Department heads composed prospective teams using a combination of people from all three categories.§部门领导从现有所有三组人中选出一些人组成**未来**的团队。§
21017§percentage§pəˈsentɪdʒ§What percentage of the workforce was employed in agriculture in this country in the mid 1900s?§在20世纪中期，这个国家从事农业的劳动力在总劳动力中占多大**比例**？§
21018§clue§kluː§If you do not know a word, you can look to the picture in this book for a clue to its meaning.§如果你碰到不认识的单词，可以通过书中的插图找**线索**来推测它的意思。§改译文：原译没有和 clue（线索）对应的词，补“找线索”
21019§stammer§ˈstæmə(r)§Left-handed children, forced to use their right hand, often develop a stammer.§本来惯用左手的小孩在被迫改用右手后，通常会患**口吃**。§
21020§swamp§swɒmp§The tsunami swamped the port city.§海啸**吞没**了这座港口城市。§
21021§jealous§ˈdʒeləs§Tom is jealous of anyone who talks to his girlfriend.§汤姆对每个和他女友说话的人都心存**妒意**。§改译文：Tom 是男性，“她女友”应为“他女友”；改译文：jealous 是嫉妒不是猜疑，改为「妒意」
21022§favour§ˈfeɪvə(r)§Darkness favoured their escape.§黑暗**有利于**他们逃跑。§
21023§fickle§ˈfɪkl§I knew that he was a fickle man, and one you could never rely on.§我知道他是个**反复无常**的人，你绝不能依赖他。§
21024§uphill§ˌʌpˈhɪl§We cycled uphill for over an hour.§我们骑自行车爬了一个多小时的**山坡**。§
21025§defence§dɪˈfens§The defences of the country must be reinforced.§该国的**防御力量**必须加强。§

21026§succeed§səkˈsiːd§One Winter Olympics has succeeded another every four years since 1924, with a break only for the Second World War.§从1924年开始冬奥会一届**接着**一届，每四年举办一次，只在二战期间中断过一次。§改译文：原译没有和 succeed（接着发生）对应的词，补“一届接着一届，”
21027§gender§ˈdʒendə(r)§The gender gap is being attenuated in modern society.§在现代社会里，**性别**差距正在弱化。§
21028§consecutive§kənˈsekjətɪv§You should give a clear and consecutive narrative for your report.§你应该就你的报告给出一个清晰、**连贯**的陈述。§
21029§diversion§daɪˈvɜːʃn§Most water diversion projects are harmful to the fish population.§大多数的水系**改道**工程都会危及鱼群。§
21030§donate§dəʊˈneɪt§I should also like to say if you do have a bike to donate, it doesn't matter what condition it is in.§我还想说如果你有自行车可以**捐赠**，不管它是什么状况都没关系。§改例句：con- dition 是排版断行残留，应为 condition
21031§volume§ˈvɒljuːm§This liquid was 10 litres in volume.§这一液体的**体积**为十升。§
21032§refund§ˈriːfʌnd§You can't get a refund if you don't have any invoices.§如果你没有发票就不能获得**退款**。§
21033§regardless§rɪˈɡɑːdləs§Regardless of the theory or model that we choose, a reduction in population size decreases the genetic diversity of a population.§**无论**我们选择何种理论或研究样本，人口减少都会降低该种群的基因多样性。§
21034§emboss§ɪmˈbɒs§The hotel's name was embossed on all the towels.§所有毛巾上都**压印**有旅馆的名字。§
21035§internationalist§ˌɪntəˈnæʃnəlɪst§We established links and access to the internationalist organisations and their resources.§我们与**国际主义者**组织建立了联系，并有权使用他们的资源。§
21036§scatter§ˈskætə(r)§The farmer scattered the seeds on the field.§农民在地里**播**种。§
21037§appetite§ˈæpɪtaɪt§My supper by this time was cold, and my appetite was gone.§我的晚餐这时候已经凉了，我也没**胃口**了。§
21038§prevail§prɪˈveɪl§The use of horses for ploughing still prevails in this area.§在这一地区用马耕地还很**普遍**。§
21039§glossary§ˈɡlɒsəri§You'll find the meaning of the difficult words used on this website in the glossary.§你能在**词汇表**中查到此网页上难词的意思。§
21040§consolidation§kənˌsɒlɪˈdeɪʃn§The global airline industry was heading towards more consolidation.§全球航空业的**合并**之风日益盛行。§
21041§mansion§ˈmænʃn§Mary and her family lived in a mansion.§玛丽一家住在一座**大房子**里。§
21042§goodwill§ˌɡʊdˈwɪl§The manufacturer will lose customers and goodwill if word gets around that the product is unreliable.§一旦产品不可靠的消息传了出去，生产商便会失去顾客及**信誉**。§
21043§amass§əˈmæs§The monopoly capitalists amassed fabulous wealth during World War II.§二战期间，垄断资本家**大发**横财。§
21044§federal§ˈfedərəl§I opened a current account at the Federal Bank.§我在**联邦**银行开了一个活期账户。§
21045§consideration§kənˌsɪdəˈreɪʃn§After a few moments' consideration, they refused the invitation.§他们**考虑**片刻后，拒绝了邀请。§
21046§grip§ɡrɪp§She gripped on to the railing with both hands.§她双手**紧紧抓住**栏杆。§
21047§galaxy§ˈgæləksi§Scientists intend to discover a sun-like fixed star in remote galaxies.§科学家们试图在遥远的**星系**中找到一颗类似太阳的恒星。§
21048§route§ruːt§This map shows the route across the mountains.§这张地图上有穿越群山的**路线**。§
21049§deficiency§dɪˈfɪʃnsi§The short child of tall parents very likely had a hormone deficiency early in life.§父母个子高而孩子个子矮，极可能是孩子幼年时分泌的荷尔蒙**不足**造成的。§
21050§opposite§ˈɒpəzɪt§The classroom is near the main entrance, just opposite the reception desk.§教室位于主入口附近，**正对着**接待处。§
21051§sensational§senˈseɪʃənl§The performance given by the newcomers is a sensational success.§新来者的表演取得了**轰动性的**成功。§改译文：原译“相当成功”没有译出 sensational（轰动性的），改为“取得了轰动性的成功”

21052§participation§pɑːˌtɪsɪˈpeɪʃn§The students below 20 years old are not given the right of participation in the ball.§20岁以下的学生不允许**参加**舞会。§改例句：give sb. the participation 搭配不当，补 right of，即 the right of participation
21053§relief§rɪˈliːf§The relief material was flown to the flood-hit districts.§**救灾**物资被空运至洪灾区。§
21054§cultivation§ˌkʌltɪˈveɪʃn§Now, the cultivation of crops and the husbandry of livestock can bring great profit.§如今，**种植**农作物和饲养牲畜能获得丰厚的利润。§
21055§pretension§prɪˈtenʃn§The woman, having fewer pretensions, is far more willing to learn.§这个女人并没有**自命不凡**，而是非常愿意学习。§
21056§harness§ˈhɑːnɪs§The dam stores water for such functions as the irrigation of crops and the harnessing of the force of gravity for the generation of electricity.§大坝的存水可以用来灌溉农作物或**利用**重力来发电等。§
21057§bent§bent§If you are buying a cot, do make sure that any metal present is not rusted or bent in any way.§购买婴儿床的时候，一定要确保床的金属不能生锈或怎么都不会被**弄弯**。§
21058§stitch§stɪtʃ§Susan is stitching her old clothes.§苏珊正在**缝**她的旧衣服。§
21059§manual§ˈmænjuəl§You should read the instruction manual carefully before fixing the air-conditioner.§安装空调前你应该仔细阅读指导**手册**。§改例句：“指导手册”应为 instruction manual，原 manual instruction 词序颠倒
21060§mite§maɪt§The hives will be replaced because of mites or an ageing or dead queen.§蜂箱会因为**螨虫**或者蜂后的衰老或死亡等情况而被更换。§
21061§burglar§ˈbɜːglə(r)§When you leave the house, make sure the windows and doors are shut, and set the burglar alarm.§当你离开房子时，务必关好门窗，并打开防**盗**报警器。§
21062§scheme§skiːm§The government has been funding a loans scheme for students in higher education since September 1990.§自1990年9月起，政府就开始为大学生贷款**计划**提供资金。§
21063§addition§əˈdɪʃn§This fruit is a welcome addition to the English diet.§这种**添加**在英式饮食中的水果很受欢迎。§
21064§sensory§ˈsensəri§Mr. Roger is a scientist working in the field of sensory perception.§罗杰先生是**感官**知觉领域的一名科学家。§
21065§materialistic§məˌtɪəriəˈlɪstɪk§Modern society is often called materialistic.§现代社会通常被称为是**物质享乐主义**的。§
21066§detach§dɪˈtætʃ§The mechanic detached the oil filter.§机修工**拆下**了滤油器。§
21067§torrent§ˈtɒrənt§As ice and snow melted, they touched off devastating torrents of mud and debris.§冰雪融化引发了破坏力极大的泥石**洪流**。§改译文：「流」单字不足以对应 torrent，改为「泥石洪流」
21068§thirsty§ˈθɜːsti§The moisture is absorbed by thirsty plants.§**饥渴**的植物吸收了水分。§
21069§clarify§ˈklærəfaɪ§Talking to students about the requirements of a course helps to clarify what needs to be done.§告诉学生课程要求有助于他们**弄清**自己所需要完成的工作。§改译文：「了解」不是 clarify 的意思，改为「弄清」
21070§inspect§ɪnˈspekt§The general inspected the troops.§将军**检阅**了军队。§
21071§seam§siːm§The sailors couldn't find anything to caulk the seams in the boat.§水手们找不到任何东西来填塞船上的**裂缝**。§

21072§agriculture§ˈægrɪkʌltʃə(r)§Agriculture still employs nearly half of the population in many developing countries, though the share is falling steadily.§在许多发展中国家，**农业**仍然雇用着近一半的人口，尽管这一比例正在稳步下降。§补例句
21073§microcosm§ˈmaɪkrəʊkɒzəm§Malaysia's universities have always been a microcosm of Malaysian society.§马来西亚的大学往往是整个马来西亚社会的**缩影**。§
